summary.ja: HLL近似Riemann流束に接触波を加え、Euler方程式の密度接触面を捉えやすくする界面流束。公開例はDavis型の左右音響波速を用いる理想気体・1次元版である。
summary.en: An approximate Riemann flux that restores the contact wave missing from HLL, improving Euler contact resolution. The released implementation is one-dimensional and perfect-gas, with Davis-type outer acoustic speeds.

code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

assumptions: Left/right states are perfect-gas Euler variables (ρ,ρu,E), finite with ρ>0 and p>0, using a physical γ>1.
Outer speeds are S_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R) and S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R); the contact speed and two star states are computed algebraically.
HLLC supplies an interface flux. Reconstruction, time integration, CFL control and boundary states are provided by the caller.
The local HLLC branch accepts Euler only; availability of HLL for another model does not make this HLLC implementation applicable to it.
units: Use one consistent unit system on both sides. ρ is density, u, c and wave speeds are length/time, and p and E are energy/volume. Numerical fluxes have conserved-variable units times length/time. γ is dimensionless; released examples are nondimensional.
boundary_conditions: Physical boundary conditions do not belong to the interface-flux function. The caller constructs left/right states; the existing one-dimensional solver uses periodic, fixed-initial-endpoint or extrapolated-edge states.

limitations.ja: 接触波の復元は一般的な正値性・エントロピー安定性の保証ではない。このDavis型波速版を、強い希薄波・真空や一般EOS、MHD、相対論的流体に追加処理なしで用いない。静止接触の一致テストも、移動衝撃波や全問題での厳密性を意味しない。
limitations.en: Contact restoration is not a general positivity or entropy-stability guarantee. This Davis-speed version should not be extended without additional treatment to strong rarefactions, vacuum, general equations of state, MHD or relativistic flow. Exact agreement for a stationary contact does not imply an exact solution for moving shocks or arbitrary problems.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 左右状態は理想気体Eulerの(ρ,ρu,E)、有限かつρ>0、p>0で、物理的な比熱比γ>1を使う。
外側波速はS_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R)、S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R)。接触速度と左右star状態を代数的に計算する。
HLLCは界面流束であり、再構成、時間積分、CFLと境界状態は呼び出し側が与える。
本実装のHLLC分岐はEuler専用であり、HLLを使える他のモデルにも自動適用できるわけではない。
units_ja: 左右で同じ単位系を使う。ρは密度、uとcと各波速は長さ/時間、pとEはエネルギー/体積。数値流束は保存量×長さ/時間の単位を持つ。γは無次元で、公開例も無次元。
boundary_conditions_ja: 界面流束そのものには物理境界条件を指定しない。呼び出し元が左右状態を作る。既存1次元solverは周期・端点初期値固定・端値外挿を用いる。

problem.ja: セル界面の左右Euler状態から、接触波を含む近似保存流束を求める。
problem.en: Compute a contact-resolving approximate conservative flux from left/right Euler states.

variant.ja: riemann.numerical_flux(...,solver='hllc')。Davis型外側波速、左右star状態、接触波を使う理想気体Euler版。
variant.en: riemann.numerical_flux(...,solver='hllc'): perfect-gas Euler HLLC with Davis-type outer speeds, two star states and a contact wave.

ja: 正の理想気体状態から、HLLより鮮明な密度接触面を求めたい。
再構成・時間積分・境界条件を別に選ぶGodunov型solverの流束部品が必要。
en: Density contacts should be sharper than with HLL for positive perfect-gas states.
A flux component is needed in a Godunov-type solver that separately selects reconstruction, time integration and boundaries.

ja: 真空や極端な希薄波に対して正値性の保証が必須。
非理想気体、浅水、MHD等のための別のHLLC定式化が必要。
en: Guaranteed positivity is required near vacuum or extreme rarefactions.
A different HLLC formulation is needed for nonideal gases, shallow water or MHD.

title.en: Sod-type particle shock tube with Gaussian-convolution GSPH

note.ja: 固定入力の式・参照・図と実行コードを対応付けます。 Gaussianの線形比体積畳み込み、対称な可変h、独立な対Riemann解と反対称な全エネルギー交換を持つGSPHです。通常SPHへp*を代入する代用ではありません。一次再構成に限定し、論文のcubic/MUSCLや一般精度を主張しません。
note.en: Bind the fixed-input formula, reference, figure and executable code. Actual Gaussian linear-specific-volume GSPH overlap with symmetric variable h, independent pair Riemann solves and antisymmetric total-energy exchange; not substitution of star pressure into ordinary SPH. First-order reconstruction only, not the paper cubic/MUSCL implementation or a general accuracy claim.
